Truth or Dare Generator

Truth or Dare with mild and wild levels — 35 truths and 35 dares, drawn without repeats.

Choose truth or dare, then draw.

Golden rule: anyone can skip any card, no questions asked.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick Truth or Dare and a level (Mild/Wild).
  2. Press Draw.
  3. Complete the card — or skip it, no pressure.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What are the levels?

Two levels: Mild (safe for everyone) and Wild (spicier, for bold groups). Choose before drawing.

How many truths and dares?

35 truths and 35 dares in total, split across Mild and Wild levels.

Is it family-safe?

Yes — everything stays playful and consensual; skip any card nobody wants to do.

How do levels work?

Draw alternates within your chosen level; switch levels anytime.
